summary: Antipolo City 1st District representative with 50 principal-authored bills. Authored bank transparency and anti-corruption mechanisms amending the bank secrecy law, an anti-dynasty ban, a call for a constitutional convention, a New Government Procurement Act amendment, redistricting Antipolo and a prohibition on deliberate false information that poses verifiable public harm with platform accountability and digital literacy.
caveat: The disinformation bill is narrowly framed around verifiable public harm with literacy provisions, and is a single speech issue, so civil liberties is not scored.
